data.body: [P2] Preserve same-thread user-function cleanup when a peer reports a plugin fatal. An interrupted peer enters this catch after `pluginFatal` is set, and this rethrow bypasses `onUserFunctionEnd` entirely despite its all-outcomes contract. OTel attempt scopes therefore cannot be restored on their owner thread; invocation finalization closes them from another thread and later releases the plugin, potentially leaking trace context into a reused executor worker. Dispatch a FAILED end hook with the original fatal before rethrowing it, preserve that fatal over cleanup failures, and give cooperative operation owners a bounded cleanup handoff before invocation finalization. Add a regression test asserting one end hook and cleared thread-local context on the reused worker.
